status: Current education and life situation; daily routines and responsibilities.
history: Education, projects, accomplishments, awards, contributions, extracurricular activities, setbacks and turning points. Preserve reported versus independent evidence.
interests: Hobbies, recreation, curiosity and activities chosen freely; no career justification required.
strengths: Specific reported or demonstrated skills, emerging capabilities, development needs and untested self-perception. No global ability score.
family_social: Family, friends, mentors, relationships and social influences. A wish is not automatically pressure; do not invent the worry behind it.
values: Values, motivations, priorities, self-perception and meaningful experiences.
pressures: Evidenced financial, practical, time and responsibility constraints; do not infer a problem merely from a relationship.
sure: Expressed uncertainty, decision needs and voluntary certainty ratings; unknown is allowed.
goals: Goals, changing aspirations and whose wish each is; revisit when priorities change.
options: Known and tentative unexplored directions, questions and beliefs to check against sources. Exploring is not choosing.
